h.en: 7.1.1 From mechanical quantity to useful data

body.en:
Start with a situation

A machine controller cannot read pressure directly;it needs a sensing element,signal conversion and a calibrated interpretation.

Definition

A sensor responds to a quantity.A transducer converts a quantity/energy form to another usable form;in instrumentation it commonly provides an electrical output related to the measurand.

Understand the reason

Measurement chain:measurand→sensing/transduction→conditioning→conversion→display/control/recording.Every stage can add error or uncertainty.

Example / application

A strain-based load cell produces a small bridge signal;an amplifier and calibrated scaling turn it into force units.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A sensor label alone does not prove the accuracy of the full measurement chain.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Machine controller સીધું pressure વાંચી શકતું નથી;sensing element,signal conversion અને calibrated interpretation જોઈએ.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Sensor quantityને respond કરે.Transducer quantity/energy formને બીજા ઉપયોગી formમાં ફેરવે;instrumentationમાં સામાન્ય રીતે measurand સંબંધિત electrical output આપે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Measurement chain:measurand→sensing/transduction→conditioning→conversion→display/control/recording.દરેક stage error કે uncertainty ઉમેરી શકે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Strain-based load cell નાનો bridge signal આપે;amplifier અને calibrated scaling તેને force unitsમાં ફેરવે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

ફક્ત sensor label આખી measurement chainની accuracy સાબિત કરતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

By measurand:displacement,pressure,force,strain or temperature.By output:analog or digital.By principle:resistive,inductive,capacitive,piezoelectric,optical and others.

In a common instrumentation convention,active means self-generating sensing output(e.g.thermocouple);passive means externally excited/modulating(e.g.strain gauge,LVDT).Other fields use these words differently,so state the convention.

Primary/secondary describe sensing sequence;contact/non-contact describe interaction;absolute/incremental describe reference behaviour where applicable.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A self-generating sensing element can still require powered conditioning/display electronics.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Measurand પ્રમાણે:displacement,pressure,force,strain,temperature.Output પ્રમાણે:analog,digital.Principle પ્રમાણે:resistive,inductive,capacitive,piezoelectric,optical વગેરે.

સામાન્ય instrumentation conventionમાં active એટલે self-generating sensing output(જેમ thermocouple);passive એટલે externally excited/modulating(જેમ strain gauge,LVDT).બીજા fieldsમાં અર્થ જુદો હોઈ શકે,એટલે convention કહો.

Primary/secondary sensing sequence,contact/non-contact interaction અને લાગુ હોય ત્યાં absolute/incremental reference behaviour બતાવે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Self-generating sensing elementને પણ powered conditioning/display electronics જોઈએ શકે.

body.en:
Definition

An LVDT uses a moving magnetic core to vary the differential coupling of an AC-excited primary to two secondary coils.

Construction:parts and purpose

A central primary coil receives AC excitation.

Two secondary coils are connected in series opposition.

A movable core couples magnetic flux without ideal sensing contact.

A mechanical link follows the displacement.

Demodulation/conditioning supplies signed position information.

Working:sequence and reason

Excite the primary with the specified AC source.

Set the reference/null position and validate the working range.

Core motion changes the two secondary amplitudes.

Differential amplitude and phase relative to excitation distinguish magnitude/direction.

Condition,calibrate and scale output to displacement within the linear range.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Ideal null has equal opposing outputs;real residual null,temperature and off-axis motion matter.LVDT is not a simple DC coil resistance sensor.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

LVDTમાં moving magnetic core AC-excited primaryનું બે secondary coils સાથે differential coupling બદલે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Central primary coilને AC excitation મળે.

બે secondary coils series oppositionમાં જોડાય.

Movable core ideal sensing contact વગર magnetic flux couple કરે.

Mechanical link displacement અનુસરે.

Demodulation/conditioning signed position information આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Primaryને specified AC source આપો.

Reference/null position set કરી working range validate કરો.

Core motion બે secondary amplitudes બદલે.

Excitationની સામે differential amplitude અને phase magnitude/direction બતાવે.

Linear rangeમાં output condition,calibrate કરી displacementમાં scale કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Ideal nullમાં opposing outputs સરખાં;real residual null,temperature,off-axis motion મહત્વનાં છે.LVDT simple DC resistance sensor નથી.

body.en:
Understand the reason

A potentiometric sensor moves a wiper along a resistive track;voltage ratio follows position under suitable loading.Wear/contact noise and excitation stability matter.

A capacitive sensor detects geometry/permittivity changes;ideal parallel plates giveC=epsilon A/g.A smaller gap increases capacitance under those assumptions.

An optical encoder supplies position counts/code;incremental encoders require a defined reference and count tracking,while absolute encoders encode position within their specified range.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Select for range,bandwidth,environment,loading,access,uncertainty and required reference—not only resolution.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Potentiometric sensorમાં resistive track પર wiper ખસે;યોગ્ય loadingમાં voltage ratio positionને અનુસરે.Wear/contact noise,excitation stability મહત્વનાં છે.

Capacitive sensor geometry/permittivity ફેરફાર શોધે;ideal parallel plates માટે C=epsilon A/g.આ assumptionsમાં gap ઓછો તો capacitance વધુ.

Optical encoder position counts/code આપે;incrementalમાં reference,count tracking જોઈએ;absoluteમાં specified rangeનું position code મળે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Range,bandwidth,environment,loading,access,uncertainty,reference પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરો,ફક્ત resolution નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

Strain changes a bonded gauge resistance;gauge factorGF=(Delta R/R)/epsilon in the stated operating range.

Construction:parts and purpose

A fine foil/grid provides strain-sensitive resistance.

A backing and adhesive transfer surface strain to the grid.

Leads and protective coating complete the installation.

A bridge/excitation system detects small resistance changes.

Amplification,temperature compensation and calibration support measurement.

Working:sequence and reason

Choose location/orientation and prepare/bond the gauge by a qualified method.

Verify bonding,insulation and bridge wiring before loading.

Apply excitation and establish reference/temperature conditions.

Convert bridge output to strain using the actual bridge model and calibration.

For force/stress interpretation,use the applicable structure/material model or calibrated load cell.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Strain is dimensionless;1microstrain=10^-6.Temperature,lead resistance,bond creep and self-heating can mimic strain.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Strainથી bonded gauge resistance બદલાય;આપેલી operating rangeમાં gauge factor GF=(Delta R/R)/epsilon.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Fine foil/grid strain-sensitive resistance આપે.

Backing અને adhesive surface strain grid સુધી પહોંચાડે.

Leads અને protective coating installation પૂરી કરે.

Bridge/excitation નાનો resistance change શોધે.

Amplification,temperature compensation,calibration measurementને ટેકો આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Qualified methodથી location/orientation પસંદ કરી gauge bond કરો.

Loading પહેલાં bonding,insulation,bridge wiring તપાસો.

Excitation આપી reference/temperature conditions લો.

Actual bridge model અને calibrationથી outputને strainમાં ફેરવો.

Force/stress માટે applicable structure/material model કે calibrated load cell લો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Strain dimensionless છે;1microstrain=10^-6.Temperature,lead resistance,bond creep,self-heating strain જેવી અસર આપે.

body.en:
Given

R120ohm,GF2,strain500microstrain,excitation5V;ideal small-strain quarter bridge,one active arm.

Stepwise solution

  1. epsilon=500×10^-6=.0005
  2. Delta R=GF×epsilon×R=2×.0005×120=.12ohm
  3. |Vout|≈Vex GF epsilon/4=5×2×.0005/4=.00125V=1.25mV

Remember / avoid this mistake

Output polarity depends on wiring and tension/compression;half/full bridges need their actual configuration equations.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

R120ohm,GF2,strain500microstrain,excitation5V;ideal small-strain quarter bridge,એક active arm.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. epsilon=500×10^-6=.0005
  2. Delta R=GF×epsilon×R=2×.0005×120=.12ohm
  3. |Vout|≈Vex GF epsilon/4=5×2×.0005/4=.00125V=1.25mV

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Output polarity wiring અને tension/compression પર આધારિત છે;half/full bridgeમાં actual configuration equations જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

Pressure is force per unit area;an elastic diaphragm can convert differential pressure to displacement/strain and then electrical output.

Construction:parts and purpose

A pressure port exposes the sensing side to the process.

A reference side defines gauge,absolute or differential sensing.

A diaphragm/elastic element deflects under pressure difference.

A strain/capacitive/other pickup and conditioning produce the signal.

Working:sequence and reason

Identify required pressure type,range,medium compatibility and overload limits.

Use qualified safe installation and isolate/depressurise before any authorised service.

Apply/reference known pressures using a suitable calibration system.

Convert conditioned output through the calibrated relation and check zero/span.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Gauge pressure references atmosphere;absolute pressure references vacuum;differential pressure compares two ports.Never mix their zero references.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Pressure unit area દીઠ force છે;elastic diaphragm differential pressureને displacement/strain અને પછી electrical outputમાં ફેરવે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Pressure port sensing sideને process સાથે જોડે.

Reference side gauge,absolute કે differential sensing નક્કી કરે.

Diaphragm/elastic element pressure differenceથી વળે.

Strain/capacitive/અન્ય pickup અને conditioning signal આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Pressure type,range,medium compatibility,overload limits ઓળખો.

Qualified safe installation લો;authorised service પહેલાં isolate/depressurise કરો.

યોગ્ય calibration systemથી જાણીતા pressures લો.

Calibrated relationથી output ફેરવી zero/span જુઓ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Gauge pressure atmosphere સામે,absolute pressure vacuum સામે,differential બે ports વચ્ચે છે;zero references ભેળવો નહિ.

h.en: 7.1.8 Force measurement:load cell and piezoelectric sensor
h.gu: 7.1.8 Force Measurement:Load Cell અને Piezoelectric Sensor

body.en:
Definition

A strain-gauge load cell uses calibrated deformation;piezoelectric force sensors generate charge under stress and suit dynamic events.

Construction:parts and purpose

A load-cell elastic body carries the intended load path.

Bonded strain gauges commonly form a compensated bridge.

Conditioning provides excitation,amplification and scaling.

A piezoelectric system uses a stressed element and suitable charge amplifier/cabling.

Working:sequence and reason

Choose load range,direction,dynamics and installation interfaces.

Mount in the intended load path and avoid side loads/overload.

Calibrate with traceable applied forces in the working configuration.

Interpret conditioned output;consider hysteresis,creep,temperature and bandwidth.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Piezoelectric systems have charge leakage and usually do not measure indefinitely static loads reliably.Mass inkg and force inN are different quantities.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Strain-gauge load cell calibrated deformation વાપરે;piezoelectric force sensor stressથી charge આપે અને dynamic events માટે યોગ્ય છે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Load-cell elastic body intended load path લે.

Bonded strain gauges સામાન્ય રીતે compensated bridge બનાવે.

Conditioning excitation,amplification,scaling આપે.

Piezoelectric systemમાં stressed element,યોગ્ય charge amplifier/cabling હોય.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Load range,direction,dynamics,interfaces પસંદ કરો.

Intended load pathમાં mount કરી side loads/overload ટાળો.

Working configurationમાં traceable applied forcesથી calibrate કરો.

Conditioned outputમાં hysteresis,creep,temperature,bandwidth જુઓ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Piezoelectricમાં charge leakageથી indefinitely static load સામાન્ય રીતે વિશ્વસનીય માપાતો નથી.Mass kgમાં અને force Nમાં જુદી quantities છે.

body.en:
Given

A calibrated linear gauge-pressure transmitter maps0–10bar to4–20mA;reading12mA.

Stepwise solution

  1. Fraction=(12−4)/(20−4)=.5
  2. Pressure=0+.5×10=5bar=500kPa

Remember / avoid this mistake

This is ideal scaling within the validated range;4mA is the live zero,not zero current;check failure/out-of-range behaviour from the specification.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Calibrated linear gauge-pressure transmitter0–10barને4–20mA આપે;reading12mA.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Fraction=(12−4)/(20−4)=.5
  2. Pressure=0+.5×10=5bar=500kPa

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ validated rangeમાં ideal scaling છે;4mA live zero છે,zero current નહિ;failure/out-of-range behaviour specificationથી જુઓ.

body.en:
Understand the reason

LVDT:position/deflection;strain gauge:structural strain;load cell:press/fixture force;pressure sensor:hydraulic/pneumatic monitoring;encoder:motion feedback.

Conditioning can include excitation,bridge completion,amplification,filtering,demodulation,isolation and ADC conversion.Choose sampling rate with bandwidth and anti-aliasing in mind.

Build an exam answer

  1. Write measurand→principle→labelled construction→working→calibrated relation→application→error sources/limitations.
Quick check: Does doubling ADC bits double accuracy?

No.Noise,reference,calibration,loading and the complete chain still matter.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

LVDT:position/deflection;strain gauge:structural strain;load cell:press/fixture force;pressure sensor:hydraulic/pneumatic monitoring;encoder:motion feedback.

Conditioningમાં excitation,bridge completion,amplification,filtering,demodulation,isolation,ADC આવે.Sampling rateમાં bandwidth અને anti-aliasing જુઓ.

પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Measurand→principle→labelled Construction→Working→calibrated relation→application→errors/limitations લખો.
જાતે વિચારો: ADC Bits બમણા એટલે Accuracy બમણી?

ના.Noise,reference,calibration,loading અને આખી chain મહત્વની રહે.
